object_description: compact raised volume with a loggia cutout
design_condition: The compact volume is positioned close to the existing building, defines northern and southern playgrounds, and uses the loggia to create a covered entrance while establishing a gap to the neighboring building.

positive.statement: The proportions, compactness, proximity, and relationship to the existing building are well understood.

position.target: proportions, compactness, and relationship to existing building
position.rationale: Main compact volume is visible across all calibrated views; neighboring-building proximity is inferred from the stated site condition.

positive.statement: The facade fits into the existing campus through a visually and structurally enriching composition.

position.rationale: Exterior composition is visible on the sampled envelope, with the front facade used as the representative anchor.

positive.statement: The efficient and compact proportions fit well into the existing complex and allow an energy-efficient volume.

position.rationale: Compact massing is visible in plan and elevations; energy efficiency remains a performance interpretation of the volume.

positive.statement: The loggia pleasantly raises the volume, creates a covered entrance, and defines the two playgrounds.

position.rationale: Central top-view cutout and lower elevation opening identify the loggia and raised covered entrance.

positive.statement: The room program is generally well solved and the ground-floor division reinforces the building's position.

position.rationale: Ground level is constrained by the lower elevation bands; interior division is not distinguishable in the exterior sample.

positive.statement: Locating the important school rooms along the facade provides natural light.

position.rationale: A perimeter surface anchor represents facade-adjacent rooms; the internal room program is not directly sampled.

negative.statement: The entrance hall seems too structured and impractical.

position.rationale: The covered entrance is localized at the front lower opening; the hall's internal structure is not visible.

negative.statement: The large empty central core is unconvincing in its form and use.

position.rationale: A distinct central void is visible in plan and reflected by discontinuities in the elevation point fields.

negative.statement: External fabric blinds limit the use of daylight in summer.

position.rationale: Blinds are not individually visible; the anchor is placed on a representative south-facing envelope surface.

negative.statement: The structural considerations and building-technology approaches are not sufficiently deepened or integrated.

position.rationale: The whole building envelope is a proxy because structural and technical systems are not separately represented.

negative.statement: The fire-protection concept has not been fully thought out or developed.

position.rationale: Fire-safety provisions are absent as distinct geometry, so the marker indicates a plausible building-system location.

negative.statement: The building's accessibility for disabled people is incorrect.

position.rationale: Accessibility is anchored at the visible covered entrance, the most relevant sampled access point.
